subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 11: Get ready for A1 Movers & Fun corner
outcomes: Answer exam questions about a picture and a listening text.
Write one word or a number for each listening answer.
Use times, subjects and frequency words in a board game.

tf.s: In Listening Part 2, you write one word or a number for each answer.
Before listening, it helps to read the notes and guess the type of word.
tf.why: Great tip! Predicting helps you listen.

tf.s: In the picture, the girl is reading a book about Science.
tf.why: Correct! Her book is about Science.

tf.s: 'How often? ___ a week' needs a time like 'half past eight'.
tf.why: It needs a frequency word like once or twice.

tf.s: In the picture, the girl's mother has got a kite.
tf.why: The girl's mother has got a bag.

tf.s: We do P.E. twice a week means two times a week.
'Do you want to play football tomorrow?' is an invitation.
tf.why: Right! Do you want to ...? invites a friend.

tf.s: In the board game you can stay on a square with a wrong sentence.
tf.why: You must complete the sentence correctly to stay there.

tf.s: Maths, Art and ICT are school subjects.
tf.why: Yes! You can find them in the word search.

boxes.q: What is the girl reading a book about?
boxes.why: She is reading a book about Science.

boxes.q: What has the girl's mother got?
How many words for each Listening Part 2 answer?
boxes.why: Write just one word or a number.

boxes.q: 'How often? ___ a week' needs a ___ word.
boxes.why: Once and twice are frequency words.

boxes.q: Answer: Do you want to play football tomorrow?

mcq.q: What should you write for each answer in Listening Part 2?
mcq.why: Short answers: one word or a number.

mcq.q: What is the girl in the picture reading?
mcq.why: She is reading a book about Science.

mcq.q: Which is a good exam tip before listening?
o: Read the notes and predict the type of word.
Write the answers before you listen.
mcq.why: Predicting helps you catch the answer.

mcq.q: Note: 'How often? ___ a week'. Which answer fits?
mcq.why: How often needs a frequency word.
A time answer needs a time or number.

mcq.q: Board game square: 'What time is it? (12.45)'
Why do we look at the picture before answering Part 6 questions?
o: The answers are in the picture.
mcq.why: Look at the picture to find the answers.

mcq.q: Which answer is too long for a one-word answer?
o: She goes on Saturdays at half past four.
mcq.why: For one-word answers, keep it short.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses unit language correctly?
o: We always have English after break.
We have always English after break.
We always has English after break.
Always we English have after break.
mcq.why: The adverb goes before have, and we use have with we.
